name: Masae Okada
source: The protagonist's friend at prep school and part-time worker. By the way, he's a second-time retaker, so he's one year older than the protagonist. To put it simply, he is an easy person to understand. He acts as he pleases and does something as promised, so those around him are always nervous. However, thanks to his charming appearance and warm-hearted character, he seems to be strangely popular.
